ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud cases, including the sources of funding and the individuals or organizations involved.
questions: What are the sources of funding for child care programs?
How are funds being misused or diverted?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can identify patterns and connections between entities and individuals involved in child care fraud, and potentially uncover larger schemes or networks.
